Author: BestiaryNav contributors
Name: Bestiary Nav
Description: Left-click Master's Bestiary entries to open acquisition map flags or select their duty in Duty Finder. Highlight nearby uncaptured beasts with level-colored model and enemy-list labels. Use the Auto Navigate toggle for optional teleporting and walking through Lifestream and vnavmesh (both required for automatic travel). Includes all 50 beasts and quest guidance. Use /bnav for settings.
Punchline: Navigate to beasts and highlight nearby uncaptured targets.
Changelog: Release 0.5.4. See GitHub releases for details.
